mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cost_archive_manifest ( `year_month` VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, csp VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, s3_key VARCHAR(512), row_count BIGINT, byte_size BIGINT, sha256 CHAR(64), status VARCHAR(20), raw_purged TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, raw_purged_at DATETIME, archived_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (`year_month`, csp), INDEX idx_archive_status (status), INDEX idx_archive_dt (archived_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT bucket_nm AS bucketNm , role_arn AS roleArn FROM temp_cmp_user_role_arn WHERE csp = 'AWS' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost_archive_manifest (`year_month`, csp, s3_key, row_count, byte_size, sha256, status, archived_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{yearMonth}, #{csp}, #{s3Key}, #{rowCount}, #{byteSize}, #{sha256}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE s3_key = #{s3Key}, row_count = #{rowCount}, byte_size = #{byteSize}, sha256 = #{sha256}, status = #{status}, archived_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cost_archive_manifest WHERE `year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND csp = #{csp}
SELECT * FROM cost_archive_manifest ORDER BY `year_month` DESC, csp

SELECT DISTINCT ym FROM ( SELECT `year_month` COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ym FROM monthly_summation UNION SELECT demand_month COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci FROM ncp_cost_vm_month UNION SELECT SUBSTRING(usage_date,1,6) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci FROM azure_cost_vm_daily UNION SELECT invoice_month COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci FROM gcp_billing_raw ) t WHERE ym REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' ORDER BY ym DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cur_origin WHERE lineitem_usagestartdate >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth},'01'),'%Y%m%d') AND lineitem_usagestartdate < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth},'01'),'%Y%m%d') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
DELETE FROM azure_cost_vm_daily WHERE usage_date LIKE CONCAT(#{yearMonth},'%')
DELETE FROM azure_cost_service_daily WHERE usage_date LIKE CONCAT(#{yearMonth},'%')
